edges.reason: msg.sender determines the minter identity, whitelist lookups and recipient in mint.
msg.sender is used for winner-list lookup, minting and claim bookkeeping in freeMint.
withdraw is restricted to the owner and sends the balance to msg.sender.
partialWithdraw is guarded by onlyOwner which compares owner() with msg.sender.
block.timestamp is compared with REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to seed startingIndexBlock.
block.timestamp is compared with REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to seed startingIndexBlock.
Constructor assigns REVEAL_TIMESTAMP from block.timestamp at deployment.
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP gate influences startingIndexBlock assignment in mint.
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP gate influences startingIndexBlock assignment in freeMint.
withdraw performs an external low-level call forwarding the whole balance.
partialWithdraw performs an external low-level call to an arbitrary address.
mint reaches _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient.
freeMint reaches _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient.
reserve reaches _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient.
freeMint subtracts _count from winnerlist[msg.sender].claimAmount.
setStartingIndex derives the index from blockhash, a weak entropy source.
A malicious recipient contract can reenter freeMint from onERC721Received before claimAmount is updated.
startingIndexBlock is consumed as the blockhash input in setStartingIndex.
setStartingIndex writes the derived value into startingIndex.
startingIndex is read and required to be zero before setting.
MAX_ELEMENTS is the modulus applied to the blockhash result.
MAX_ELEMENTS bounds total + _count and the mint loop in mint.
MAX_ELEMENTS bounds total + _count and the mint loop in freeMint.
MAX_ELEMENTS bounds total + _count in reserve.
privateMintPrice * _count is compared with msg.value in mint.
publicMintPrice * _count is compared with msg.value in mint.
maxToMint bounds the buyer balance expression in mint.
